recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized, painterly portrait of a smiling man in a dark suit and light blue shirt, rendered with visible, expressive brushstrokes against a textured olive-green background. The composition is framed by a white header bar and features heavy, slanted sans-serif typography in high-contrast colors.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm, orange-toned skin of the portrait contrasts against the cool olive and teal background strokes.
The rigid, geometric white header bar stabilizes the fluid, expressive painting below.
The bold, slanted display type mirrors the energetic verticality of the background brushwork.
coreInvariants: Visible impasto-style brushstrokes throughout the portrait and background.
A white horizontal bar at the top containing secondary metadata.
A high-contrast color palette of olive green, teal, orange, and white.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered in the lower two-thirds of the frame, cropped from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes and smile, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold display text at the top, moves down to the subject's face, and is then led by vertical brushstrokes to the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the painting area provides breathing room for the primary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Olive green and muted teal provide the atmospheric background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm ochre and peach tones define the skin and highlights of the portrait.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright orange-red is used for secondary display text to pop against the green.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white header and dark suit; medium saturation in the background to allow the face to stand out.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' is a wide, tilted oval.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, slanted display face paired with a clean, upright grotesque for functional information.
graphicDevices: Small square logo containers in the upper left

preserve: The oblique angle of the main title
The extended width of the characters

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and specific mid-century feel.
Captures the wide, geometric, and slanted aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an impressionistic oil painting of a smiling man in a suit, using thick impasto brushstrokes. The color palette should be dominated by olive green, teal, and warm orange skin tones. Leave the top 10% of the image as a solid white bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, heavy, slanted geometric sans-serif title in the upper left of the painting area. Add smaller, wide-tracked grotesque text inside the white header bar at the top.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait rendered with visible, thick paint texture?
Is the main title text slanted and extremely bold?
Is there a clear white bar at the top for metadata?
Does the color palette feel like a 1960s print?

adjustableVariables: Width of the white header bar
mustRedesign: Artist name and album title text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the brushstrokes are visible and not blurred.
Check that the text is perfectly horizontal despite the internal slant of the letters.
Verify the white header bar is clean and distinct from the painting.
Confirm the color palette is cohesive and retro-inspired.
recipe.reuseFormula: Impressionistic portrait + [Subject] + [Primary Color Palette] + White Header Bar + Heavy Oblique Sans-Serif Typography.
